request: Goal: make POSIX agent process-tree termination reach a finite timeout outcome and correctly distinguish live members, zombies, and reused PIDs. Scope: src/lib/agent.js timeout escalation and process-group liveness plus Linux /proc/<pid>/stat parsing shared with src/lib/process-identity.js. Required outcomes: after SIGTERM then SIGKILL, polling has a final deadline; parenthesized comm supports correct state, pgrp, and start fingerprint extraction; PID reuse and zombie-only groups are not treated as original live members; timeout retains the required member identity/state diagnostics; normal close then SIGTERM then SIGKILL ordering remains. Verification: stubborn-child final deadline, zombie-only settlement, PID-reuse identity, spaced-comm parser, and existing normal escalation tests. Out of scope: Windows taskkill implementation and changes outside the POSIX timeout or Linux stat parsing paths.
